The diverter will be installed throughout this interval. Gumbo Shales The gumbo-type shales occur between c. 850m and 1800m but sticky clays are present throughout the Tertiary. These caused minor problems in all 2/1 wells apart from wells and mai

The depositional clay matrix is dominated by illite, with some swelling clay, kaolinite and chlorite, although some of these clays are partially authigenic (Table 2). Mollusc shell fragments and belemnites are scattered throughout and also concentrated
